deadline.value: The Mechanical Engineering Ph.D. page does not state an application deadline.

gre_general.value: GRE General exam is not required, though Ph.D. applicants are particularly encouraged to submit GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: A GRE exam is not required but encouraged. GRE scores will be used in evaluating the applicant, should the applicant choose to provide these scores. ... Applicants for the Ph.D. program are particularly encouraged to submit their GRE scores.

gre_subject.value: ETS does not offer a GRE Subject Test in Mechanical Engineering.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The Mechanical Engineering Ph.D. pages do not state whether pre-admission supervisor agreement is required.

funding.value: The Mechanical Engineering Ph.D. pages do not state guaranteed or competitive funding terms for doctoral students.

entry_route.value: Accepts students directly with a bachelor's degree (72 semester hours of graduate coursework) or with a related master's degree (42 semester hours beyond the master's).
entry_route.quote: For a student who possesses a bachelor’s degree, a minimum of 72 semester hours of graduate-level coursework will be required. | For a student who possesses a master’s degree in a related field, a minimum of 42 semester hours (credits) of graduate-level coursework beyond the master’s degree will be required.
